label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The benches retain the foreground-to-midground hierarchy, but the authored view presents a sparse workshop vignette and does not meaningfully show the wall-side stove.

The pale bench has a brown dotted top, blue vise and three leg-hung accessories, but no readable folding mechanism. Perforations appear as surface dots, and only one yellow frame fitting is clearly visible.
The elongated rear bench has many tan-brown circular ends with varied diameters, face tones and dark bark-like rims, reading as a simplified log-end mosaic.

The blue drill press and CNC bed, gantry and spindle are recognizable and ordered correctly. The left rail carries a rectangular block assembly without a sufficiently recognizable plunge-saw silhouette.
A stocked multi-tier lumber rack is present, but the hanging objects read as plain rods without clamp jaws, and the shelving contents read as solid blocks rather than recognizable bins or tubs.
A dark stove with a recessed front door and connected upward stovepipe is clearly visible in the side view.
The pale bench panels, layered top assembly, tan rear worktop and board-built shelving sustain a simplified plywood/MDF construction language.
The visible gray floor reads as a uniform studio plane. Render grain and lighting gradients do not establish concrete mottling, wear or seams.

Native lamp arms and shade are supported by actual meshes. A 70-energy warm area light sits at the shade, while two elevated warm area lights supply overhead illumination. The authored view shows a brighter local worktop area beneath the lamp.
The elevated front three-quarter view reveals the bench top and supports and leaves bottom-edge callout space, but the stove is hidden and the storage context is substantially cropped.

The original final.png is a fully decoded, readable PNG. The blend opened successfully and retains editable meshes, assigned node materials, three lights and an active camera consistent with the delivered view. No minimum pixel dimensions are specified by this criterion.

dimension_scores.evidence: The principal bench arrangement and color landmarks correspond, but equipment silhouettes, storage density and workshop detail are substantially simplified.
Major furniture appears supported and machines sit on worktops. Folding joints, clamp mechanics and some furniture connections lack convincing functional construction.
White and tan boards, blue machine accents, orange clamps and dark background fixtures preserve the palette, while boxy forms lose distinctive silhouettes.
Coherent shadows provide volume, but primitive machine shapes, flat circular log faces, absent surface detail and strong delivered-image noise reduce credibility.
Parallel benches and the left-to-right equipment order read clearly. Background fixtures retain their wall-side relationship, though the final view obscures the stove.
Furniture and machinery have broadly plausible relative sizes, but the hero bench appears unusually tall relative to the rear bench, and the room feels oversized and underfilled.
Warm overhead and local lamp illumination work coherently. Uniform surfaces provide little distinction between wood, metal and concrete, and the delivered render is noticeably noisy.
Both benches, drill press, CNC, lamp, lumber rack and stove are present. Recognizable saw detail, hanging-clamp storage, bins and complete folding-bench features remain deficient.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
